signature.name: Edinburgh Castle
signature.detail: The city's defining sight, crowning Castle Rock with the Honours of Scotland and the Stone of Destiny. Book tickets online in advance and arrive at opening time to beat the crowds.

signature.name: Royal Mile
signature.detail: The historic spine of the Old Town, linking the Castle to the Palace of Holyroodhouse past closes, kirks and street performers. Walk it early in the morning before the tour groups arrive.

signature.name: Palace of Holyroodhouse
signature.detail: The monarch's official Scottish residence, full of royal history and Mary, Queen of Scots' chambers. Check opening days in advance as it closes for royal events.

signature.name: Calton Hill
signature.detail: A short climb rewards you with the classic panorama of the city and the National Monument. Go at sunset for the best light; it is an easy walk from Princes Street.

signature.name: Forth Bridge
signature.detail: A UNESCO-listed engineering icon spanning the Firth of Forth. View it from South Queensferry, reachable by train from Edinburgh in about 20 minutes.
